svg.text: POWER FIRST | Shared 12 V → L7805 → 5 V VIN
Logical nets, not hole positions. Verify L7805 TO-220 marking and NodeMCU VIN before connection.
PHOTO ORIENTATION: NodeMCU USB connector at left
UPPER red rail = +5 V LOWER red rail = +12 V BOTH blue rails = common GND
1 IN 2 GND 3 OUT
Heatsink / tab = GND
Lower rail: +12 V
Upper rail: +5 V → NodeMCU VIN
Common GND → supply −, both blue rails, NodeMCU GND, driver GND and pump return
Both ceramic capacitors sit directly beside the regulator pins; connect their other ends to GND.
AT VIN: 10 µF / ≥16 V electrolytic (+ to 5 V, − to GND) and 1k / 0.25 W load (5 V to GND).
PIN VIEW: printed face toward you, leads down → LEFT 1 IN / CENTER 2 GND / RIGHT 3 OUT.
Three regulator leads must occupy separate contact strips. Metal-back view reverses left/right.
Keep the grounded heatsink clear of live pins. Check split rails; never join +12 V to +5 V.
12 V SUPPLY DISTRIBUTION: fuse branches appropriately; share a common ground point.
Separate secure wires → A4988 VMOT and pump +12 V; separate power returns to supply −.
Breadboard +12 V feeds only the regulator branch. Do not route motor/pump current through rails.
Keep local 100 µF / 25 V bulk capacitors at VMOT and pump switch (see diagrams below).
3V3 stays separate: NodeMCU 3V3 → A4988 VDD, MS1/2/3, RESET/SLEEP and EN pull-up.
USB: disconnect external VIN lead before attaching USB; unplug USB before reconnecting VIN.
TEST: verify 12 V and 5 V before connecting NodeMCU; then verify its 3V3 and regulator temperature.
HEAT: (12 − 5) × load current = 1.4 W at 200 mA, plus internal loss. Validate heatsink under load.
Button: D2 to GND only when pressed. Verify tactile-switch pairs by continuity, not appearance.
